key: HARDY: Yo, \PN!
en: HARDY: Yo, \PN!
ja: ハーディ: よう、\PN!

key: Cain went off to go see some friends of his who are up here, I guess.
en: Cain went off to go see some friends of his who are up here, I guess.
ja: カインは、こっちにいる友達に会いに行ったみたいだぜ。

key: Where's Aya?
en: Where's Aya?
ja: アヤはどこだ?

key: ...She what, mate?
en: ...She what, mate?
ja: ……あいつが何だって、相棒?

key: Captured?
en: Captured?
ja: 捕まった?

key: 'Scuse me.
en: 'Scuse me.
ja: ちょっと失礼。

key: CHARLOTTE: 'Sup?
en: CHARLOTTE: 'Sup?
ja: シャルロット: どうも。

key: That was a pretty fun show, huh?
en: That was a pretty fun show, huh?
ja: なかなか面白いショーだったでしょ?

key: Don't worry about the whole 'throw me to the dogs' thing.
en: Don't worry about the whole 'throw me to the dogs' thing.
ja: 「わたしを見捨てる」うんぬんの件は、気にしなくていいから。

key: You gave the right answer.
en: You gave the right answer.
ja: 正しい答えを出したわよ。

key: In any situation where someone is making an ultimatum, you never acquiesce to it.
en: In any situation where someone is making an ultimatum, you never acquiesce to it.
ja: 誰かが最後通告を突きつけてくる状況では、絶対に応じちゃだめ。

key: Case in point, Team Meteor could kill every person in Labradorra City, but that doesn't get them anything they need.
en: Case in point, Team Meteor could kill every person in Labradorra City, but that doesn't get them anything they need.
ja: 例えば、チームメテオがラブラドラシティの住人を皆殺しにしたところで、あいつらが必要なものは何も手に入らない。

key: So as long as we don't bargain with them, they won't reach their goals.
en: So as long as we don't bargain with them, they won't reach their goals.
ja: だから、あいつらと取引をしない限り、目的は達成させない。

key: But if we give in like your little friend Hardy wanted to, that would have just validated all their power and encouraged that behavior.
en: But if we give in like your little friend Hardy wanted to, that would have just validated all their power and encouraged that behavior.
ja: でも、あんたの友達のハーディが望んでたみたいに折れてたら、あいつらの力を認めて、その行動を助長するだけだった。

key: That's all it is.
en: That's all it is.
ja: 結局、それだけのこと。

key: Rewards and punishment, really.
en: Rewards and punishment, really.
ja: 本当に、アメとムチの話。

key: We just have to train them.
en: We just have to train them.
ja: あいつらを、しつけてやればいいだけ。

key: Turns out humans aren't that different from animals after all.
en: Turns out humans aren't that different from animals after all.
ja: 結局、人間も動物とそう変わらないってこと。

key: I don't care if that sounds manipulative or callous.
en: I don't care if that sounds manipulative or callous.
ja: それが操作的とか冷酷に聞こえても構わない。

key: I don't have the liberty of feeling guilt like most people.
en: I don't have the liberty of feeling guilt like most people.
ja: たいていの人みたいに、罪悪感を感じる余裕なんて、わたしにはないから。

key: That right burned away years ago.
en: That right burned away years ago.
ja: その権利は、何年も前に燃え尽きた。

key: That was sweet of you and all, to say you'd save me, but a little naive.
en: That was sweet of you and all, to say you'd save me, but a little naive.
ja: わたしを助けるって言ってくれたのは優しいけど、ちょっと甘いわね。

key: But if we give in like you said, that would just validate their little power game.
en: But if we give in like you said, that would just validate their little power game.
ja: でも、あんたの言う通りに折れてたら、あいつらのちっぽけな力比べを認めるだけだった。

key: They get what they want, and there's no guarantee they release any hostages either.
en: They get what they want, and there's no guarantee they release any hostages either.
ja: あいつらは望むものを手に入れて、それでも人質を解放する保証なんてどこにもない。

key: Completely stupid.
en: Completely stupid.
ja: 完全に馬鹿げてる。

key: I'll keep the ring for now.
en: I'll keep the ring for now.
ja: 指輪は、当面わたしが預かっておく。

key: It'll be best to keep them on their toes and guessing about who's holding it.
en: It'll be best to keep them on their toes and guessing about who's holding it.
ja: 誰が持ってるのか分からないまま、あいつらを警戒させておくのが一番いい。

key: Knowledge is power, and that's power they won't have.
en: Knowledge is power, and that's power they won't have.
ja: 知識は力。そして、それはあいつらには渡さない力よ。

key: So, Anna told me about the issue with Ametrine.
en: So, Anna told me about the issue with Ametrine.
ja: それで、アメトリンの件、アンナから聞いたわ。

key: You need to use Dive, right?
en: You need to use Dive, right?
ja: 『ダイビング』が必要なんでしょ?

key: Don't ask me whose bright idea it was to make the Fire Leader enable a Water Machine.
en: Don't ask me whose bright idea it was to make the Fire Leader enable a Water Machine.
ja: ほのおタイプのリーダーに水のマシンを解禁させるなんて、誰の思いつきなのか聞かないでちょうだい。

key: This'll be my first proper battle in Mom's Gym, so I gladly accept your challenge.
en: This'll be my first proper battle in Mom's Gym, so I gladly accept your challenge.
ja: これがママのジムでの、初めてのちゃんとしたバトルになるから、あんたの挑戦、喜んで受けるわ。

key: We'd better do it now while Team Meteor's still distracted.
en: We'd better do it now while Team Meteor's still distracted.
ja: チームメテオがまだ気を取られてるうちに、やっておいたほうがいい。

key: How about something else for a change?
en: How about something else for a change?
ja: たまには気分を変えて、別のことにしない?

key: I hear you're still racking up Gym Badges, and it just so happens I'm still a Leader.
en: I hear you're still racking up Gym Badges, and it just so happens I'm still a Leader.
ja: まだジムバッジを集めてるんでしょ。ちょうど、わたしもまだリーダーやってるし。

key: The Gym in this city was Mom's before it passed down to me, but thanks to Sigmund's need to control every aspect of our lives, I've never even used it.
en: The Gym in this city was Mom's before it passed down to me, but thanks to Sigmund's need to control every aspect of our lives, I've never even used it.
ja: この街のジムは、わたしが継ぐ前はママのものだったけど、シグムンドがわたしたちの生活を何もかも管理したがるせいで、一度も使ったことがなかった。

key: Personally, I'm burning to change that.
en: Personally, I'm burning to change that.
ja: 個人的には、それを変えたくてうずうずしてる。

key: Let's do it now while Team Meteor's still distracted.
en: Let's do it now while Team Meteor's still distracted.
ja: チームメテオがまだ気を取られてるうちに、やりましょう。

key: I'll meet you over there.
en: I'll meet you over there.
ja: 向こうで待ってる。

key: CHARLOTTE: ...Hm.
en: CHARLOTTE: ...Hm.
ja: シャルロット: ……ふぅん。

key: I never found Laura.
en: I never found Laura.
ja: ローラは見つからなかった。

key: Oh well, I'm sure she'll be fine.
en: Oh well, I'm sure she'll be fine.
ja: まあ、きっと大丈夫でしょ。

key: The attack has stopped.
en: The attack has stopped.
ja: 攻撃は止まった。

key: For now, Calcenon City has been declared safe to enter.
en: For now, Calcenon City has been declared safe to enter.
ja: 現時点で、カルセノンシティへの立ち入りは安全と宣言されている。

key: There've been no changes in the city so far.
en: There've been no changes in the city so far.
ja: 今のところ、街に変化はない。

key: I'll continue keeping watch for any suspicious individuals who may try to infiltrate the city.
en: I'll continue keeping watch for any suspicious individuals who may try to infiltrate the city.
ja: 街への侵入を試みる不審者がいないか、引き続き見張っておく。

key: ATTENDANT: Thank you again for your generosity.
en: ATTENDANT: Thank you again for your generosity.
ja: 係員: ご厚意、改めて感謝いたします。

key: ATTENDANT: Sorry, this road through was destroyed.
en: ATTENDANT: Sorry, this road through was destroyed.
ja: 係員: すみません、この先の道は壊れてしまっていて。

key: You won't be able to pass.
en: You won't be able to pass.
ja: 通ることができません。

key: It's a real shame, too.
en: It's a real shame, too.
ja: 本当に残念です。

key: We only just spent all that money carving out the stairway and building the bridges.
en: We only just spent all that money carving out the stairway and building the bridges.
ja: 階段を切り開いて、橋を架けるのに、せっかくお金をかけたばかりだったのに。

key: We might not be able to repair the bridges any time soon, but if we had the funds, we could get a quick fix on the stairway.
en: We might not be able to repair the bridges any time soon, but if we had the funds, we could get a quick fix on the stairway.
ja: 橋の修理はすぐには難しいかもしれませんが、資金さえあれば、階段のほうは手早く直せると思います。

key: Would you be willing to donate anything?
en: Would you be willing to donate anything?
ja: 何か、ご寄付いただけませんか?

key: If we can raise enough money, the stairway could be completed quickly.
en: If we can raise enough money, the stairway could be completed quickly.
ja: 十分なお金が集まれば、階段はすぐに完成させられます。

key: \GIt would probably cost about $40,000 in total.
en: \GIt would probably cost about $40,000 in total.
ja: \Gだいたい、全部で$40,000くらいかかると思います。

key: ATTENDANT: That's-- oh my word.
en: ATTENDANT: That's-- oh my word.
ja: 係員: それは――なんてことでしょう。

key: I'll set the crew to work right away!
en: I'll set the crew to work right away!
ja: すぐに作業員を働かせます!

key: Done in record time!
en: Done in record time!
ja: 記録的な速さで完了しました!

key: The road is now open! Thank you so much!
en: The road is now open! Thank you so much!
ja: 道が開通しました! 本当にありがとうございます!

key: ATTENDANT: Er, that's very generous of you, but you don't even have that much.
en: ATTENDANT: Er, that's very generous of you, but you don't even have that much.
ja: 係員: えっと、大変ご丁寧にありがとうございます、ただ、そんなに持っていらっしゃらないようですが。

key: Still, the thought is appreciated.
en: Still, the thought is appreciated.
ja: それでも、お気持ちはありがたく頂戴します。

key: ATTENDANT: That's all right.
en: ATTENDANT: That's all right.
ja: 係員: 大丈夫ですよ。

key: Someday.
en: Someday.
ja: いつか、ですね。

key: \GThe remaining repairs total $ \v[333].
en: \GThe remaining repairs total $ \v[333].
ja: \G残りの修理費用は、合計$\v[333]です。

key: ATTENDANT: How much would you like to donate?
en: ATTENDANT: How much would you like to donate?
ja: 係員: いくらご寄付いただけますか?

key: ATTENDANT: Then-- that's it! That's all we need!
en: ATTENDANT: Then-- that's it! That's all we need!
ja: 係員: それなら――それで足ります! 必要な分は全部そろいました!

key: ATTENDANT: Thank you very much! This will be a huge step towards our goal!
en: ATTENDANT: Thank you very much! This will be a huge step towards our goal!
ja: 係員: 本当にありがとうございます! 目標に向けた大きな一歩になります!

key: CHARLOTTE: 'Sup, \PN?
en: CHARLOTTE: 'Sup, \PN?
ja: シャルロット: どうも、\PN。

key: You're probably wondering what happened to Saphira here.
en: You're probably wondering what happened to Saphira here.
ja: きっと、サファイラに何があったのか気になってるでしょ。

key: The truth is...
en: The truth is...
ja: 実を言うと……

key: I finally set her on fire too.
en: I finally set her on fire too.
ja: とうとう、あの子にも火をつけちゃった。

key: CHARLOTTE: Hah! Just kidding.
en: CHARLOTTE: Hah! Just kidding.
ja: シャルロット: はっ! 冗談よ。

key: Did you believe me?
en: Did you believe me?
ja: 本気にした?

key: CHARLOTTE: Ahaha! Good! That's fun.
en: CHARLOTTE: Ahaha! Good! That's fun.
ja: シャルロット: あはは! いいわね! 面白い。

key: But you should know I would never do anything to harm my sister.
en: But you should know I would never do anything to harm my sister.
ja: でも、わたしが妹を傷つけるようなことは絶対にしないって、分かっておいて。

key: And if anyone else tried, I'd burn them instead.
en: And if anyone else tried, I'd burn them instead.
ja: 他の誰かがそうしようとしたら、代わりにその人を燃やしてやる。

key: Got it?
en: Got it?
ja: 分かった?

key: CHARLOTTE: Really? Geez.
en: CHARLOTTE: Really? Geez.
ja: シャルロット: 本気で? やれやれ。

key: I would never do anything to harm my sisters.
en: I would never do anything to harm my sisters.
ja: わたしが姉妹たちを傷つけるようなこと、絶対にしないから。

key: CHARLOTTE: Awh, boring.
en: CHARLOTTE: Awh, boring.
ja: シャルロット: あー、つまんない。

key: CHARLOTTE: Yeah? Too bad.
en: CHARLOTTE: Yeah? Too bad.
ja: シャルロット: そう? 残念。

key: But I guess you were right.
en: But I guess you were right.
ja: でも、あんたの言う通りだったみたいね。

key: Maybe you understand after all.
en: Maybe you understand after all.
ja: 案外、分かってくれてるのかも。

key: I found her like this in the Control Center under Calcenon.
en: I found her like this in the Control Center under Calcenon.
ja: カルセノンの地下にある制御センターで、この状態のあの子を見つけたの。

key: She said she was going there, but she was taking way too long, so I went to go get her.
en: She said she was going there, but she was taking way too long, so I went to go get her.
ja: そこに行くって言ってたのに、あまりにも時間がかかりすぎてたから、迎えに行ったのよ。

key: With everyone disappearing or whatever, obviously that's not the smartest move.
en: With everyone disappearing or whatever, obviously that's not the smartest move.
ja: みんな消えたりしてる状況で、それが賢いやり方じゃないのは分かってる。

key: It's like a horror movie or whatever, right?
en: It's like a horror movie or whatever, right?
ja: ホラー映画かなんかみたいでしょ?

key: Just don't split up.
en: Just don't split up.
ja: とにかく、離れちゃだめ。

key: Duh.
en: Duh.
ja: 当たり前でしょ。

key: Like you are now, huh?
en: Like you are now, huh?
ja: 今のあんたみたいにね?

key: But if anything did happen to her, I wouldn't really care what happened to me.
en: But if anything did happen to her, I wouldn't really care what happened to me.
ja: でも、あの子に何かあったら、自分がどうなろうと本当にどうでもよかった。

key: There wouldn't be a point.
en: There wouldn't be a point.
ja: 意味なんてないもの。

key: So I went for it.
en: So I went for it.
ja: だから、行ったの。

key: Found her like this.
en: Found her like this.
ja: この状態で見つけた。

key: Hauled her here.
en: Hauled her here.
ja: ここまで運んできた。

key: Was just taking a break in here-- turns out, carrying someone like her isn't the easiest thing.
en: Was just taking a break in here-- turns out, carrying someone like her isn't the easiest thing.
ja: ちょっとここで休憩してただけ――あの子を運ぶのって、思ったより大変なのよ。

key: She's in rough shape, but alive.
en: She's in rough shape, but alive.
ja: ひどい状態だけど、生きてる。

key: That's what matters.
en: That's what matters.
ja: それが大事なところ。

key: And believe me, if I thought Team Meteor was responsible for this, Labradorra City would already be torched.
en: And believe me, if I thought Team Meteor was responsible for this, Labradorra City would already be torched.
ja: それに、もしこれがチームメテオの仕業だと思ったら、ラブラドラシティはもう焼け野原になってるはず。

key: But judging by the damage down there, she probably did this to herself.
en: But judging by the damage down there, she probably did this to herself.
ja: でも、下の被害の様子からすると、たぶんあの子が自分でやったんだと思う。

key: Went on a rampage.
en: Went on a rampage.
ja: 暴れ回って、

key: Took it out on some defenseless machine.
en: Took it out on some defenseless machine.
ja: 無防備な機械に八つ当たりしたのよ。

key: Probably shocked herself in the process.
en: Probably shocked herself in the process.
ja: たぶん、その過程で自分にも感電したんでしょうね。

key: And take a look at her hand.
en: And take a look at her hand.
ja: それと、あの子の手を見て。

key: That's a lock of Laura's hair, impressively still clenched in her fist.
en: That's a lock of Laura's hair, impressively still clenched in her fist.
ja: それ、ローラの髪の毛の束よ。よくもまあ、まだ握りしめたままね。

key: Looks like a clean cut to me.
en: Looks like a clean cut to me.
ja: きれいに切られてるように見える。

key: Team Meteor probably took it from her and left it down there as bait.
en: Team Meteor probably took it from her and left it down there as bait.
ja: たぶんチームメテオがローラから切り取って、餌としてあそこに置いていったんだと思う。

key: It's just a guess, but I'm assuming Saphira saw it and went into a frenzy.
en: It's just a guess, but I'm assuming Saphira saw it and went into a frenzy.
ja: ただの推測だけど、サファイラがそれを見て、逆上したんだと思う。

key: Wouldn't be the first time.
en: Wouldn't be the first time.
ja: 今回が初めてってわけでもないし。

key: So they have Laura too, and they want us.
en: So they have Laura too, and they want us.
ja: つまり、あいつらはローラも捕まえてて、わたしたちが欲しいってわけ。

key: All of us, probably.
en: All of us, probably.
ja: たぶん、全員ね。

key: You're gonna do something about it?
en: You're gonna do something about it?
ja: 何か手を打つつもり?

key: CHARLOTTE: That's right, wrecking ball, take the bait so we don't have to.
en: CHARLOTTE: That's right, wrecking ball, take the bait so we don't have to.
ja: シャルロット: そうそう、鉄球さん、代わりにその餌に食いついてきなさいよ。

key: Make that horror movie dream come true.
en: Make that horror movie dream come true.
ja: あのホラー映画の夢、かなえてあげて。

key: CHARLOTTE: That's the sensible thing.
en: CHARLOTTE: That's the sensible thing.
ja: シャルロット: それが分別のある判断ってやつね。

key: But who ever got anywhere by being sensible?
en: But who ever got anywhere by being sensible?
ja: でも、分別があるだけで、どこかにたどり着けた人なんている?

key: As much as I also want to go look for Laura, I'm not leaving Saphira alone like this.
en: As much as I also want to go look for Laura, I'm not leaving Saphira alone like this.
ja: わたしもローラを探しに行きたい気持ちはあるけど、この状態のサファイラを置いていくつもりはない。

key: So whatever you're doing, good luck.
en: So whatever you're doing, good luck.
ja: だから、あんたが何をするにしても、頑張って。

key: CHARLOTTE: Guess it took me a while to lug Saphira this far up here after all.
en: CHARLOTTE: Guess it took me a while to lug Saphira this far up here after all.
ja: シャルロット: サファイラをここまで運んでくるのに、結局けっこう時間かかっちゃったみたい。

key: Whatever.
en: Whatever.
ja: まあ、いいけど。

key: I'll get her back to safety soon enough.
en: I'll get her back to safety soon enough.
ja: そのうち、あの子を安全な場所に連れて帰るから。

key: In the meantime, raise some hell for me.
en: In the meantime, raise some hell for me.
ja: それまでの間、わたしの代わりに暴れてきて。

key: There's no response.
en: There's no response.
ja: 返事はない。

key: A long, clean lock of pink hair is wound inside her still-clenched fist.
en: A long, clean lock of pink hair is wound inside her still-clenched fist.
ja: きれいに切られたピンクの髪の束が、まだ握りしめられた拳の中に巻きついている。

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
